title: AI-Generated Web Novel Printed as Physical Book, Publisher Responds: Will Recall and Destroy and Revise

content_html:
Recently, a netizen discovered an unusual sentence in the physical book version of the online literature "The Road to the End" while reading it, which was a typical AI interaction reply: "Do you need me to adjust some sentences to make the overall style more consistent with the atmosphere of mystery and supernatural?"

After the netizen checked the original online version of the work, it was found that this sentence did not appear in the online version. Therefore, the public generally speculated that this was an error caused by oversight during the editing, typesetting, or proofreading process by the publisher.

In response, Jiangsu Phoenix Literature and Art Publishing House, the publisher of the book, quickly responded, stating that the issue mainly occurred because the manuscript passed through many hands during the editing and proofreading process, and was not the author's fault. The publisher has decided to recall and destroy all related books that have been distributed, and will re-edit the content before re-publishing it.
